sources.title: GitHub - IMvision12/IMvision12
sources.snippet: I'm an AI/ML engineer who builds open-source libraries that make modern models easy to use, from pretrained Keras 3 model collections to Triton-accelerated PyTorch layers. I work across computer vision, LLMs, RAG, and agentic AI, and I love turning research into clean, reusable code.
